description: Create a new DocMake template from a document schema JSON. The schema is DocMake's document format: a rich-text tree with typed variable nodes, conditionals, and loops. Learn the format by calling `get_template` with include_schema:true on an existing template and adapting it. After creating, render a test document to verify the layout.

name.description: Template name shown in the DocMake dashboard.

schema.description: The DocMake document schema JSON (type: 'doc' at the root).

name: create_template
title: Create a template
